description: Instant price for printing a 3D file (STL, 3MF or OBJ, by public URL or base64). Our live quote engine slices it server-side and returns price (AUD, no GST), grams, print time, size, printability checks (fits printer, watertight, thin walls), bulk prices and a review_and_pay_url. Creates a saved quote. STEP/IGES files are quoted on the quote page. Materials: PLA, PETG and PLA Matte in stock; TPU, ABS, ASA, carbon/glass-fibre and 20+ more filaments ordered in (+2-3 days); SLA, SLS, MJF and metal via our production network (~2-3 weeks); live list in quote_options. Equivalent plain GET endpoint: https://formada3d.com/api/quote/v1/quote?file_url=<public STL link>&material=PLA&qty=1&format=text

business.description: true = business customer (review/pay link on business.formada3d.com, invoice/PO available).

colour.description: Black, White, Grey, Silver, Red, Blue, Navy, Green, Yellow, Orange, Purple, Pink, Beige, Brown, Teal or Clear (default Black).

file_base64.description: The file bytes as base64 (up to 8 MB decoded). Use instead of file_url.

file_name.description: File name incl. extension, e.g. "bracket.stl" (needed with file_base64).

file_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the 3D file (STL, 3MF or OBJ; up to 25 MB). STEP/IGES must be uploaded on the quote page (converted in the browser).

lead.description: standard 3-5 business days (ordered-in filaments +2-3 days, production-partner materials ~2-3 weeks); express 48 h dispatch (+30%, in-stock materials only); economy 8-12 business days, 15% off the print price (A$8 minimum still applies; not for production-partner materials).

material.description: Default PLA. Instant, in stock (3-5 business days or express 48 h): PLA, PETG, PLA_MATTE. Ordered in for the job (instant price, +2-3 days, no express): TPU, PLA_SILK, PLA_METAL, PLA_GALAXY, PETG_TRANS, ABS, ASA, PLA_CF, PETG_CF, PAHT, PLA_MARBLE, PLA_SPARKLE, PLA_GRADIENT, PLA_WOOD, PLA_GLOW, PLA_TRANS, PLA_TOUGH, PLA_PURE, PETG_MATTE, PC, PC_FR, PA6_CF, PA6_GF, PET_CF, PPS_CF, TPU85, TPU90. Industrial production via our production network (instant price, ships in ~2-3 weeks, A$8 setup per order, colour fixed by the material): MJF_PA12, SLS_PA12, SLS_PA12GB, SLA_WHITE, SLA_GREY, SLA_BLACK, SS316L, TI64, PEEK, PEKK, PA12_CF, ABS_ESD.

notes.description: Notes for us about the part (max 500 chars).

parts.description: Several files in one quote (max 5). Each item: {file_url | file_base64, file_name, quantity, material, colour, infill, notes}. Top-level settings apply when an item omits them.

units.description: Units the file was modelled in (default mm).
